item.title: Chronobiology reveals the hidden temporal organization of European beech forest phenology
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04246-9

European beech forests show region-specific seasonal timing, with spring leaf-out being event-driven while autumn changes are more closely synchronized with annual climate rhythms, as shown by satellite time series measurements combined with climate data.
item.dc:title: Chronobiology reveals the hidden temporal organization of European beech forest phenology
item.dc:creator: Sofia Bajocco
Carlo Ricotta
Simone Bregaglio

item.title: Probabilistic multi-horizon spatiotemporal forecasting of injection-induced seismicity in geothermal systems
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 24 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04200-9

QuakeCastNet forecasts seismicity rates and spatial distributions at two geothermal sites, where the network improves early forecasts, decay adaptation addresses shut-in conditions absent from network training, and the sites show contrasting temporal and spatial responses.
item.dc:title: Probabilistic multi-horizon spatiotemporal forecasting of injection-induced seismicity in geothermal systems
item.dc:creator: Zhengfa Bi
Nori Nakata
